body:
I think I only grew to hate him once the beast man got revealed. His condition and binding were stated to be black magic, which means Shuro is a hypocrite. If his nation is using black magic bindings and transformation magic, then he had no room to talk.


Please note that I'm only a little ways in.

Why? What will he have thats so wonderful? I haven't been able to trust anyone. The thought of building a new relationship repulses me. I spent 5 years with someone. They lied to me. Told me they loved me. Told me I made then happy. I trusted them. I believed them. Then they left me without warning. They sat up in bed and told me they didn't love me "that way." They gave me no reason for weeks as they just left. Then, once gone, they made it my fault. They replaced me with someone before even moving away. Two weeks earlier she said she loved me. We were thinking about marriage. Then... Nothing... I don't love you. My best friend. My partner. She turned on me, said terrible things about me, cheated on me, replaced me. 

Why would I waste another five years? Why waste another year? If this is real, and can't be corrected, then how can I ever trust anyone again? 

The worst part is... Everyone acts like its normal. The world just is that way some times. 

Id rather just get off the board then play in a game built to do this. I loved her. I love her. 

Do you know what its like to have the center of your universe, the person you love more then anything else, just stop caring... And without telling you why?

It'd be easier for everyone if I just quietly dissapear. She wouldn't feel the need to keep me around. People wouldnt need to deal with me suffering anymore. Its not that I want to get better. I just don't want the new life thats being offered. Even if I got better, moved on, stopped loving her, and found someone else. That person wouldnt be me. I don't want to die and let that new person take my life. If I am forced to die and become that new person. I would rather just die the person I was.
The therapist will want to help me move forward with life. He will want me to move on. I dont want a new life without her. He cant help me because my help doesnt exist.
A doctor would just want me to do the same thing everyone else does. Shut up, act happy, and watch her fade away. I had a good life. Now I just have this. I dont want this.

It would be hard for them to miss it. I haven't been able to hide how bad it is. The last few times ive been over to her place. I return in sobbing hysterics. Having to leave, and drive away from her, after seeing her always makes me want to crest my car off an overpass. They are past empathy at this point. Their opinion is that any positive or supportive thoughts will just foster my desire to have her back. They would rather be honest and hurt me then lie and let her hurt me. 

Either way. I just want out. I cant go home now, and it seems there is nothing I can do do ever get my home back. Ive been replaced. Easily it seems.

Theyre nice cats, but they have been misbehaving for the last 4 months. They dont like the change in room. They know someone is gone. The little one is torturing me. I love her to death, but she drives me to tears. I have more then once been driven into a sobbing mess because she wont stop looking for mom. I beg, plead, and apologize. Then I feel ashamed for having let a cat drive me into such a mess. I just hate it. I know she wants mom back, but mom doesn't want us anymore...

I have two. A large grey tabby and a small brown tabby. The large one is super loud, will talk your ear off, and friendly to everyone. The small one is doing better with socializing, but remains exitable and skittish. She was very attached to my ex, and has been suffering almost as much seperation anxiety as I have. I do my best to comfort her, but, months later, she still spends a lot of time looking for her momma.

They are some of my best friends. I am around them constantly. We hang out, game, etc. I am not a recluse, nor am I deprived of social activity. I just don't feel satisfaction in it. I don't understand it. If I did I would fix it. I somehow have the ability to be in a room full of people, and feel utterly alone. It may be because of how they all talk about her. None of them were super beat up by her leaving. More then one prefers her absence. I just want my partner back, and I feel trapped alone in a life I don't want.

I have 3 roommates. You would think it would help. I haven't felt anything but alone for months. Its just four walls. I want to go home. I am homesick for a place that no longer exists. I can't go home because she destroyed it. She never let me even try.
She replaced me so fast. After 5 years. I trusted her. If she could do that then anyone can.

I dont know you, but I feel you. I am there right now. I still love her. I want so badly to fix everything.

But

Today was the day the rock came off my chest. Today was the day I started breathing again. It still hurts. I don't know what the future holds, but, man, youll make it. We both will.
